slides.fact: _to slide in on a shrimp sandwich_: to get something easily, without having to work for it.

slides.title: Who slides in on a shrimp sandwich?
slides.body:
Someone who got a great job through their parents, or won without really trying. It's usually said with a bit of envy.

A *räkmacka*, an open shrimp sandwich, is a Swedish classic and a small luxury.

slides.sv: Han har *glidit in på en räkmacka* hela livet.
slides.en: He's had it easy his whole life.

caption:
Glida in på en räkmacka: to slide in on a shrimp sandwich. It means getting somewhere easily, without having to work for it.

Macka is a casual word for sandwich, and a räkmacka (an open shrimp sandwich) is a Swedish classic.
